## About
The Pet Wellness Clinic is a family owned and operated hospital in Magnolia. We're here for routine checkups, a much needed vaccination, or an emergency snake bite, with clean, well-lit facilities and up-to-date equipment.
Dr. Don is a graduate of Texas A&M University and school of Veterinary Medicine, and he is a certified Animal Nutritionist. He believes the key to a long, happy life for your pet is prevention: regular vaccinations, a healthy diet and natural supplements.
The good stories and hot coffee are always flowing, and Ginger, our clinic's best friend, waits to greet you at the door. Pet owners have given us a 4.5 rating from 120 Google reviews.

## Services
- Surgical suite: A full service surgical suite on site for the critical moments when your pet's health can't wait.
- Checkups and vaccinations: Routine checkups and vaccinations to keep your dog or cat healthy and catch problems early.
- Pet nutrition: Dr. Don is a certified Animal Nutritionist and can help you find a healthy, balanced diet for your dog or cat.

## FAQ
Q: Can I bring my pet in the same day they get sick?
A: Give us a call. A reviewer whose dog had a ruptured anal gland and a fever was told to come right in and was seen as a walk in that same day.

Q: Who do I call for an emergency after hours?
A: Our contact page lists an emergency phone line with Dr. Quillivan, DVM. You can also call the clinic during regular hours.

Q: What should I do before my first visit?
A: You're welcome to download our new client information sheet and fill it out ahead of time so it's ready when you arrive.
